title: Chapter 369: War General Puppet
content:
Chapter 369: War General Puppet

The general puppet is similar to the golden armor warrior made by Wang Shuo earlier, but the combat power is definitely different.

Wang Shuo used the Bloodthirsty Gun to lightly tap, and the general puppet waved his arm, and a lightsaber suddenly appeared in his hand.

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows, and the spear and the lightsaber collided, rubbing and sparking.

Wang Shuo felt the power of the sword.

Shocked in his heart, Wang Shuo only used 50% of his strength in this attack.

The spear was directly knocked away and almost slipped out of his hand.

Wang Shuo did not dare to be careless and began to attack with all his strength.

A move of "Dragon Transformation Strike" hit the puppet's chest, and the puppet retreated a few steps, but it seemed that no damage was caused.

After a few rounds, Wang Shuo figured out the details of the general puppet.

The general puppet's attack power is similar to his own, but its defense power is quite abnormal.

It is difficult for Wang Shuo to break his defense.

In desperation, Wang Shuo can only defend carefully and strive to hit the same place on the general puppet every time he attacks.

Wang Shuo felt that no matter how strong the defense was, he could always break it by attacking the same part repeatedly.

After fighting for half an hour, Wang Shuo was already exhausted.

Using the big move continuously, Wang Shuo's internal force was consumed very quickly.

Compared with the battle in Chitong Mountain, this time was not as dangerous, but it was definitely not easy.

The most important thing was that Wang Shuo was completely awake at this time, knew the pain, and did not dare to fight for his life.

This was also the most likely problem to occur during the battle.

If one side did not have the courage to fight to the death, the battle would often not be able to exert 100% of its strength.

If forced into a desperate situation, in most cases, a person's potential would explode and exert his strength beyond normal.

Wang Shuo wanted to replenish some water of life, but found that he could not use it at all.

Now he was a little panicked. He had no resurrection coins and could not use supplies.

Looking at the endurance of the puppet, he was obviously not as good as it!

Wang Shuo was really a little panicked now.

He made mistakes one after another, and the general puppet seized the opportunity and slashed him twice.

The red flame armor on his body was finally shattered.

Wang Shuo felt distressed. The gold-level equipment was no longer enough to deal with the general.

The weeping blood spear in his hand was also worn out, and the tip of the spear was knocked off an inch.

Carefully observing the surrounding environment, Wang Shuo thought about countermeasures.

It was really not easy to enter the second floor.

The surrounding terrain was very simple, and there was no place to use.

Wang Shuo had to take out the dream crystal flower.

He created an illusion to confuse the general puppet.

But the illusion created by the dream crystal flower had no entity, and the general puppet's attack passed through without hindrance.

The illusion still caused some interference to the general puppet, giving Wang Shuo a chance to breathe.

Wang Shuo gradually had new ideas in his mind.

He used the "multiplication technique" to upgrade his rank to the intermediate general. Although his strength did not increase, his momentum changed.

The general puppet ignored Wang Shuo's changed aura and only attacked the illusion.

Wang Shuo was delighted, it really worked.

This general puppet was indeed not smart enough and could only attack the set target.

With a move of "Li Dai Tao Jiang", Wang Shuo finally had a chance to catch his breath.

While the general puppet was attacking the illusion, Wang Shuo found the right time and easily attacked the key parts of the puppet.

After several consecutive attacks, the general puppet could no longer hold on and was beaten to smoke and completely scrapped.

[Congratulations on passing the test. ]
